name: crux-growth-skills
description: Free Crux skills for your own AI assistant. They work best with a Crux Growth Brain connected. The plugin carries a Black Friday plan (last year's Black Friday read on your own data, your November and December targets tested against it, and an agreed plan with day-by-day targets you can download) and a performance diagnosis (why a KPI moved between two periods, split into its levers, with the main driver found and what to do about it).
